headline: Wall Street Drops Sharply Despite Anthropic's Historic IPO
summary: US stocks retreated sharply even as Anthropic completed a historic IPO. Investors continue to bet on a Federal Reserve rate increase in December and another likely in January.
why: The S&P 500 tracks 500 large US companies and is the main benchmark for US equity performance, while Federal Reserve rate decisions drive global borrowing costs.
why_moved: Wall Street retreated sharply, with investors continuing to bet on a Federal Reserve rate increase in December and another likely in January.
original_headline: Wall Street retrocede con fuerza a pesar de la histórica OPI de Anthropic
